verdict.rationale: There is no documented export or offboarding feature. However, IMAP/SMTP access to inboxes lets any standard client pull mail out over an open protocol. The fully documented API (public OpenAPI spec) allows programmatic retrieval of messages, threads and attachments. Custom domains let users keep their addresses when they leave. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk-export or account-export feature, documented open export formats (e.g. mbox/EML) for labels, lists and metadata, data-deletion/offboarding docs, and independent evidence of a successful migration.
